incident-bot: [ALERT] ZephyrHealth (tenant:z-health-0912) - eu-west-1 dedicated pool rp-42 p99 latency spike. p99=5.9s over 15m. Paging @anna.oncall, @miguel_sre. Incident ID INC-4961237890

anna.oncall: On call, joining. Oncall runbook link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tenant-isolation>
miguel_sre: I'm on. Quick ask: customer impact? SLOs?
anna.oncall: p95 ~2.8s (baseline 1.2s), p99 5.9s (baseline 1.8s). Error rate stable (0.2%). High tail on long prompts (>=1024 tokens).
rose_support: ZephyrHealth reports UI latency and some request timeouts for batch export job.
amy_liaison: Customer escalation open; they're seeing slow autocomplete and export failures.
sara_englead: Prioritize tenant isolation + fallback. Miguel, can we route them to warm spare and scale pool by 2 GPUs?
miguel_sre: I'll do quick checks and then enact routing policy. Nikhil — can infra add warm spares and ready burst capacity?
nikhil_infra: Warm spares available in eu-west-1 zone-a. Can add 2 GPUs to dedicated pool in ~4m. Provisioning now.
miguel_sre: Temporarily reduce tenant weight for z-health-0912 to 0.15 to reduce impact on shared KV cache.
anna.oncall: Applying routing policy now:
```
# reduce tenant weight
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/routing/tenants/z-health-0912/actions \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \n  -d '{"action":"set_weight","value":0.15}'
```
miguel_sre: Also enabling fallback to quantized variant gptj-8q-p for heavy requests:
```
POST /v1/route_policies
{
  "tenant": "z-health-0912",
  "fallback_model": "gptj-8q-p",
  "criteria": {"latency_ms": 2000}
}
```
rose_support: Notifying customer that we're routing heavy jobs to fallback and scaling pools, ETA 6m :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
anna.oncall: Observability: p99 dropped to ~3.1s after weight change and fallback enabled. Continuing to monitor.
miguel_sre: Infra completed +2 GPUs, node ids: euw-a-10,euw-a-11. Autoscaler back to healthy.
nikhil_infra: Confirmed nodes added and joined pool rp-42.
amy_liaison: Customer replied: "Thanks, we see improvement but export still slow. We'll hold until you confirm full recovery."
sara_englead: Next steps: keep fallback running for 30m, collect traces for long prompts, schedule tenant review to tune batching. Assign postmortem owner.
anna.oncall: Postmortem owner: miguel_sre. I'll start notes in #postmortems/incidents.
ops-bot: Incident INC-4961237890 status -> mitigated. Time to mitigation ~9m. Please update when closed.
anna.oncall: Handoff to night oncall @liam.oncall in 30m. All responses tracked. :thumbsup:
